Vortex PT 1.0.0 Public Version:
• Official Public Production Release.
• Persistent Templates & User Settings in %APPDATA%\VortexPT.
• Enhanced Tendon ID Block (BLOQUE1 & BLOQUE1_L) with automatic slope alignment and zero mirroring.
• Hardware-Locked Cloud Licensing with Supabase 24/7 backend.
• Exact ADAPT & RAM Concept detailing and profile fidelity.
